property_summary: After a call to Collect(uint256), the sender's balance is decreased by the withdrawn amount.
After a call to Collect(uint256), the total sum of balances (over all addresses) does not increase by more than the amount sent to the caller.
The balance of any address remains non-negative after any sequence of operations ending with a Collect call.
After a Collect call, the caller's balance plus the contract's balance is unchanged.
The sender's balance after Collect is old balance minus the withdrawn amount.
The balances mapping value at any address is always at least the MinSum when a Collect call succeeds.
Before Collect is called, the sum of all balances is preserved; the total supply of ether held by the contract plus the sum of balances remains constant across a successful Collect call.
After any Collect call, the sender's balance is always less than MinSum when MinSum was previously set.
For any Collect call, if the caller's balance is at least MinSum after the call, then the caller must have had enough balance before the call to cover the amount.
After a Collect call, the sum of balances plus the contract's ether balance is unchanged if the call succeeded.
The balance of any address never increases as a side effect of a Collect call.
After Collect reverts, the caller's balance does not change.
After Collect with parameters that satisfy both conditions, the caller's balance remains unchanged by the modification.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance equals the previous balance minus the withdrawn amount.
For any address, its balance is nonnegative after any sequence of operations ending with a Collect call that does not revert.
After a Collect of the full balance, the caller's balance is always zero.
After any Collect call, the sum of all balances recorded in the mapping is non-decreasing relative to before the call.
After any Collect call, the total balance recorded in the contract's mapping (summed over all addresses) is at most the previous total balance plus the amount withdrawn in that Collect call.

After a Collect call that does not revert, the caller's balance in the mapping is equal to its pre-call balance minus the withdrawn amount, provided the caller had sufficient balance and the amount is not zero.
After any successful Collect call, the total balance recorded in the contract's mapping (summed over all addresses) is unchanged.
The sum of all balances in the contract is conserved (does not increase) after a successful Collect call, regardless of the caller and amount.
The balance of the caller does not increase after a successful Collect call.

After Collect, the sum of balances[caller] before and after is non-decreasing relative to the amount sent, while the contract's ether balance decreases by at most the sent amount — but only for the reference.
The total ether held by the contract (address(c).balance) plus the sum of all user balances is non-increasing after a successful Collect call.
After Collect, the caller's balance decreases by exactly _am if the call succeeds, and the sum of all stored balances plus contract Ether equals the original sum plus msg.value.
After any sequence of calls ending with Collect, MinSum must equal the last value set by SetMinSum or 0 if never set.
After any call to Collect, the value of MinSum must be the last value set by SetMinSum, or 0 if never set.
After any sequence of calls ending with Collect, the contract's balance (in wei) must equal the sum of all deposits minus the sum of all successful collects.
After a call to Collect(uint256), the value of MinSum must be the value set by the most recent call to SetMinSum(uint256) if it was ever called, otherwise 0.
After a call to Collect(uint256) that succeeds (does not revert), MinSum must not change from its value before the call.
Collect does not change MinSum when it succeeds.
After Collect(uint256) reverts, MinSum remains unchanged from its initial value.
After any sequence of operations ending with Collect(uint256), MinSum is never modified from its initial value unless SetMinSum was called before initialization.
After any call to Collect (whether it succeeds or reverts), MinSum remains unchanged from its initial value.
MinSum is never modified after initialization, even through calls to Collect.
After calling Collect(uint256), the contract's MinSum state variable must equal the value passed to SetMinSum when initialized.
After a Collect call, the contract's MinSum value must be zero if the bug is present, but the reference version preserves the set value.
After a Collect call, the contract's MinSum state variable must remain set to the value passed to SetMinSum if initialized, but the bug forces it to zero regardless.
After Collect, MinSum is unchanged from its value after SetMinSum when initialized.
After calling Collect, MinSum must equal the value set by SetMinSum when initialized.
After a Collect call, the number of messages in the LogFile's history must be zero if no deposits have been made, otherwise it must equal the number of deposits.
After calling Collect with a zero amount, the MinSum state variable remains unchanged.
After a successful Collect call, the LogFile contract stored at address(Log) must have a non-zero-length history array if at least one Deposit was made before the Collect.
After a Collect call, the LogFile contract's last message's Data field is not equal to 'Collect' if no deposit was made before the Collect.
After calling Collect, the stored LogFile address must remain the same as initially set.
After a Collect call that does not revert, the balance of the caller should decrease by the collected amount, regardless of which LogFile address is set.
After any successful Collect call, the LogFile address stored in the contract must be the one that was set during initialization.
After any call to Collect, the Log state variable stored in the contract must equal the address that was set via SetLogFile during initialization.
After a successful Collect call, the LogFile address stored in the contract must be the address that was set via SetLogFile during initialization.

After any call to Collect, the Log file address stored in the contract must be the address that was set via SetLogFile during initialization, regardless of whether the Collect call succeeded or reverted.
After Collect() is called, the LogFile address in C remains unchanged.
After any sequence of calls ending with Collect, the value of c.LogFile() remains the address of the LogFile contract set during initialization.
After Collect() is called, the LogFile address remains the address set during initialization (not zero).
After Collect() is called, the LogFile address stored in C is equal to the address initialized by SetLogFile.
After Collect() completes, the LogFile address in C is either unchanged or zero if Collect() reverts due to initialization check.
The balance of msg.sender is never increased by a Collect call (i.e., the sum of sent Ether ≤ withdrawn balance).
The deposit and collect log messages for a given address can never exceed the total balance changes of that address.
The LogFile address is never changed by a Collect call.
After any Collect call, the LogFile address stored in C remains unchanged.
After a Collect call, the LogFile address stored in the contract remains unchanged.
After Collect(uint256) is called, whether the transaction reverts depends only on the caller's balance and the amount requested, not on SetLogFile's existence.

After Collect(uint256) is called and returns without reverting (i.e., balances[msg.sender] >= MinSum and balances[msg.sender] >= _am and the call succeeds), the LogFile's History length increases by exactly 1, and the last History entry's Val equals _am.
After Collect(uint256), the caller's balance decreases by exactly _am when the call succeeds.
After Collect(uint256) is called, the state variable SetLogFile remains unchanged (i.e., the Log address is not modified) regardless of the outcome of the call.
After calling Collect with any parameters, the SetLogFile address always equals the initial zero address if SetLogFile was never called.
